newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Over 130 bodies found in Indonesian riot-hit city.
newsitem.headline: Over 130 bodies found in Indonesian riot-hit city.

text.p: Rescue workers said on Sunday they had found at least 130 bodies while sifting through the debris of a shopping complex gutted during a riot in the Indonesian city of Banjarmasin.
"So far we have 130 bodies that have been found. There are still many more," said one rescue worker, who did not want to be identified.
The riot erupted in the South Kalimantan provincial capital on Borneo island on Friday on the final day of campaigning for Indonesia's general elections set for next Thursday.
Rescue workers said most of the bodies were on the second level of the four-storey Mitra Plaza shopping and cinema complex.
One rescue worker said the dead were all looters who were afraid to emerge when troops and police arrived to quell the riot.
"There were no employees of the shops among them," he said.
